nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=35 beats='Miri arrives at the henhouse behind Birchwood Primary on the second morning of the school holiday and finds Bramble and Clover pacing by the wire door, but the smallest hen, Nutmeg, is missing and the gate latch hangs unhooked.'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=30 beats='Miri looks around the schoolyard for a place to start: the vegetable garden with its tall bean poles, the toolshed with its half-open door, or the old oak tree by the pond where Nutmeg likes to dust bathe.'>>

choices.label: Look by the old oak tree

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=35 beats='Miri pushes through the tall bean poles in the vegetable garden, checking each shadowy row for a flash of speckled brown feathers, and spots two places worth a closer look.'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=30 beats='Two clues catch Miri eye at once: a gap worn into the back fence and a trail of feathers drifting toward the compost heap, and she must choose which lead to follow.'>>

choices.label: Check the gap in the fence
Follow the feathers to the compost heap

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=30 beats='Miri kneels by the gap and finds tufts of down snagged on the wire; Nutmeg must have squeezed through here in the night, and the trail leads off into the darkening neighboring field.'>>

choices.label: Follow the trail past the fence

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=35 beats='Miri follows the trail until the light fades and the field grows too dark to search safely; Nutmeg is still missing, but Miri marks the spot to start again first thing tomorrow.'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=35 beats='The toolshed door creaks as Miri peers inside; rakes and buckets crowd the dim space, but an old toolbox with its lid ajar and a cracked window at the back both catch her eye.'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=30 beats='Two places to check first inside the toolshed, and only a moment to decide between the toolbox and the cracked window.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=20 beats='Miri creeps closer to the old wooden toolbox, its lid propped open just a crack, and hears the faintest rustle from somewhere inside among the folded rags.'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=20 beats='Miri lifts the toolbox lid all the way and there is Nutmeg, curled up cozy among the rags, having wandered in out of the wind the night before.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=25 beats='Miri carries sleepy Nutmeg back to Bramble and Clover, who cluck a noisy happy welcome, and the coop latch gets a new hook that very afternoon so it cannot happen again.'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=35 beats='Miri jogs to the old oak tree that leans over the school pond, where Nutmeg loves to scratch for bugs, and spots a ripple by the water and a dark hollow low in the trunk.'>>

choices.label: Look closer by the oak tree

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=30 beats='Two clues wait by the oak tree, and Miri must pick one to check first: the rippling water or the shadowy hollow in the trunk.'>>

choices.label: Peek at the edge of the pond

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=20 beats='Miri tiptoes toward the water where a low root pokes above the surface, and something small and speckled brown is perched right on top of it, feathers fluffed in the morning sun.'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=20 beats='It is Nutmeg, sunning herself safely on the low root, unharmed and unbothered by all the fuss, clucking a small contented cluck at the sight of Miri.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=25 beats='Nutmeg rides back to the coop tucked inside the jacket worn by Miri, and spends the rest of the holiday morning dust bathing right where everyone can see her.'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=65 beats='By the compost heap, the clues finally line up, and so does Miri friend Deshawn, who heard the search from his yard next door; together they hear one faint cluck drifting from somewhere close by, though the sound could be coming from the hedge tunnel, the rain barrel, or Mr. Ostrow shed across the yard.'>>

choices.label: Follow the sound to the hedge tunnel

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=35 beats='Miri and Deshawn crouch at the mouth of the old hedge tunnel that runs along the schoolyard fence, listening for another cluck before deciding how to go in.'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=30 beats='The tunnel is narrow, so the two of them weigh two plans before choosing one: crawling in after the sound, or waiting and calling softly.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=65 beats='Miri crawls in on hands and knees and finds Nutmeg gently tangled by one foot in a loop of twig; a few careful tugs and the little hen hops free into the open air, clucking happily as Deshawn cheers from outside the hedge.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=65 beats='Miri calls softly and waits, but the cluck fades further away down the tunnel, too far to follow before the light starts to fade; she and Deshawn tie a bright ribbon on the hedge to mark the spot and promise to try again first thing tomorrow.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=35 beats='Deshawn leads the way to the old rain barrel behind the toolshed, where a scuffle of feathers is caught on the splintered wood along the rim.'>>

choices.label: Look closer at the rain barrel

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=30 beats='The barrel stands tall, so the two of them weigh two ways to check inside it: peeking over the rim, or carefully tipping the water out.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=65 beats='Miri stands on tiptoe and finds Nutmeg roosting calmly on the rim of the barrel, having climbed up overnight to stay dry above the wet grass; she lifts the little hen down to cheers from Deshawn, who says the whole search had been her idea all along.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=65 beats='Deshawn helps tip the barrel, but only a small splash of water and a startled frog come out; soaked shoes and no hen, though the frog makes them both laugh, and they head off together to check the hedge tunnel next.'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=35 beats='Miri and Deshawn find Mr. Ostrow, the school caretaker, sweeping the front steps, and tell him about Nutmeg; he sets down his broom and offers to help them look right away.'>>

choices.label: Ask Mr. Ostrow where to look

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=30 beats='Mr. Ostrow knows two good places to check and lets Miri pick one first: his own garden shed, or his cat, Soot, who has been curled up on the porch all morning.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=65 beats='Mr. Ostrow unlocks his shed and there is Nutmeg, tucked into a folded tarp for warmth, having slipped in through a gap he promises to fix that very afternoon; she clucks a greeting at the sudden daylight.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=65 beats='Sure enough, behind the porch cushion, Nutmeg is dozing safely against the side of sleepy Soot the cat, warm and unbothered; from then on the two of them share that same sunny spot every day of the holiday.'>>
